title: Computability
description: Turing imagined the simplest machine that can compute anything, and proved it cannot always tell whether it will ever stop.

puzzle.goal: Count the Turing machines with n states that read and write two symbols: each state and symbol needs a symbol to write, a way to move and a next state (or halt). Write how many machines N there are.
puzzle.name: Counting machines
puzzle.method: Each of the 2n cases picks one of 2 symbols, 2 moves and n + 1 next states: 4(n + 1) choices, 2n times.
